source_text: Decisions that are hard to reverse or expensive to change deserve a written design doc (ADR) recording the alternatives considered and why they were rejected.
pattern: Decisions that are hard to reverse or expensive to change deserve a written design doc (ADR) recording the alternatives considered and why they were rejected.
reason: A written record prevents re-litigating settled decisions.

source_text: Prefer the simplest design that meets requirements; add abstraction only when a second concrete use case demands it (Rule of Three / YAGNI).
pattern: Prefer the simplest design that meets requirements; add abstraction only when a second concrete use case demands it (Rule of Three / YAGNI).
reason: Unneeded abstraction is a maintenance tax.

source_text: Define module boundaries by what changes together and for the same reason (cohesion); a component with two reasons to change is a future bug farm.
pattern: Define module boundaries by what changes together and for the same reason (cohesion); a component with two reasons to change is a future bug farm.
reason: Cohesion is the cheapest bug prevention.

source_text: Model the data and its invariants before the UI or the API; most design errors are data-model errors discovered late.
pattern: Model the data and its invariants before the UI or the API; most design errors are data-model errors discovered late.
reason: Late data-model errors are the most expensive to fix.

source_text: Every architecture choice is a tradeoff; a design that lists no alternatives and no costs has not been designed, only sketched.
pattern: Every architecture choice is a tradeoff; a design that lists no alternatives and no costs has not been designed, only sketched.
reason: Naming the rejected alternatives is what makes a design defensible.

source_text: Prefer many fast unit tests over a few slow e2e tests; the testing pyramid is a cost-and-feedback-speed argument, not dogma.
pattern: Prefer many fast unit tests over a few slow e2e tests; the testing pyramid is a cost-and-feedback-speed argument, not dogma.
reason: Fast feedback is what makes tests run at all.

source_text: One test asserts one behavior; when a test breaks, the failure should name the behavior, not force a forensic read.
pattern: One test asserts one behavior; when a test breaks, the failure should name the behavior, not force a forensic read.
reason: Failure messages are the tests' documentation.

source_text: Tests must be deterministic — no wall-clock time, no network, no shared mutable state; a flaky test destroys trust in the whole suite.
pattern: Tests must be deterministic — no wall-clock time, no network, no shared mutable state; a flaky test destroys trust in the whole suite.
reason: Trust is the entire point of a test suite.

source_text: Every bug fix ships with a regression test that fails before the fix and passes after; without it the bug is only suppressed, not fixed.
pattern: Every bug fix ships with a regression test that fails before the fix and passes after; without it the bug is only suppressed, not fixed.
reason: The reproducer is the proof of the fix.

source_text: Coverage measures risk exposure, not correctness; aim for high coverage on core logic and boundaries, not vanity line coverage everywhere.
pattern: Coverage measures risk exposure, not correctness; aim for high coverage on core logic and boundaries, not vanity line coverage everywhere.
reason: Coverage is a map of where you are not looking.

source_text: Fail loudly and early: a silent failure or swallowed error becomes a production mystery; an explicit error is a diagnosable event.
pattern: Fail loudly and early: a silent failure or swallowed error becomes a production mystery; an explicit error is a diagnosable event.
reason: Silent failures are the hardest to fix.

source_text: Make side-effecting operations idempotent; retries, webhooks, and queues will deliver the same event more than once.
pattern: Make side-effecting operations idempotent; retries, webhooks, and queues will deliver the same event more than once.
reason: Duplicate delivery is a fact of distributed systems.

source_text: Every external call needs a timeout and a retry policy with backoff; unbounded waits turn a slow dependency into a full outage.
pattern: Every external call needs a timeout and a retry policy with backoff; unbounded waits turn a slow dependency into a full outage.
reason: Without timeouts, slowness cascades into downtime.

source_text: You cannot fix what you cannot see: metrics, structured logs, and traces are features, not afterthoughts.
pattern: You cannot fix what you cannot see: metrics, structured logs, and traces are features, not afterthoughts.
reason: Observability turns 'it broke' into 'this broke'.

source_text: Prefer graceful degradation over hard failure; a feature that returns a partial or cached result beats a 500 that takes the whole service down.
pattern: Prefer graceful degradation over hard failure; a feature that returns a partial or cached result beats a 500 that takes the whole service down.
reason: Partial availability beats total outage.

source_text: Treat every input as untrusted at the trust boundary; validate and escape at the edge, not deep in the call stack.
pattern: Treat every input as untrusted at the trust boundary; validate and escape at the edge, not deep in the call stack.
reason: Validation at the edge stops injection at the source.

source_text: Grant the minimum privilege necessary; a background job that holds admin credentials turns one bug into a full breach.
pattern: Grant the minimum privilege necessary; a background job that holds admin credentials turns one bug into a full breach.
reason: Privilege is the blast radius of a bug.

source_text: Never commit secrets; use environment variables and a secret store, and rotate anything that was ever exposed.
pattern: Never commit secrets; use environment variables and a secret store, and rotate anything that was ever exposed.
reason: A committed secret is a public secret.

source_text: Dependency CVEs are real risk: audit dependencies on a schedule and patch known vulnerabilities before adding new features.
pattern: Dependency CVEs are real risk: audit dependencies on a schedule and patch known vulnerabilities before adding new features.
reason: Your supply chain is part of your attack surface.

source_text: STRIDE-style threat modeling catches the architectural assumptions OWASP checklists miss; run both.
pattern: STRIDE-style threat modeling catches the architectural assumptions OWASP checklists miss; run both.
reason: Checklists find known bugs; threat models find design holes.

source_text: Code is read far more than written; write for the reader, and let clear names and small functions replace comments.
pattern: Code is read far more than written; write for the reader, and let clear names and small functions replace comments.
reason: Readability is a feature the next maintainer pays for.

source_text: Track technical debt explicitly as tasks; debt you cannot see is debt you will pay with interest at the worst time.
pattern: Track technical debt explicitly as tasks; debt you cannot see is debt you will pay with interest at the worst time.
reason: Invisible debt compounds silently.

source_text: Delete dead code and dead branches; keeping them 'just in case' guarantees confusion and a false maintenance surface.
pattern: Delete dead code and dead branches; keeping them 'just in case' guarantees confusion and a false maintenance surface.
reason: Dead code still gets read, and still gets blamed.

source_text: Follow the project's existing conventions over personal preference; consistency compounds, and style churn is a tax on every future reader.
pattern: Follow the project's existing conventions over personal preference; consistency compounds, and style churn is a tax on every future reader.
reason: Consistency is a compounding readability asset.

source_text: Refactor in small, behavior-preserving steps with tests green at each step; big-bang rewrites are how systems die.
pattern: Refactor in small, behavior-preserving steps with tests green at each step; big-bang rewrites are how systems die.
reason: Small steps make regression impossible to miss.

source_text: Measure before optimizing; a profiler beats intuition, and premature optimization is the root of much complexity.
pattern: Measure before optimizing; a profiler beats intuition, and premature optimization is the root of much complexity.
reason: Optimize what the profiler names, not what you guess.

source_text: Beware N+1 query patterns and per-item network calls; batch and index at the data layer before tuning code.
pattern: Beware N+1 query patterns and per-item network calls; batch and index at the data layer before tuning code.
reason: The data layer is where most latency actually lives.

source_text: Optimize the hot path only; shaving milliseconds off code that runs once a day is wasted risk.
pattern: Optimize the hot path only; shaving milliseconds off code that runs once a day is wasted risk.
reason: Effort should follow execution frequency.

source_text: For web apps, watch bundle size and time-to-interactive; code-split and lazy-load what the first paint does not need.
pattern: For web apps, watch bundle size and time-to-interactive; code-split and lazy-load what the first paint does not need.
reason: First paint is the only performance users feel directly.

source_text: Cache at the right layer and invalidate deliberately; a stale cache is a correctness bug wearing a performance costume.
pattern: Cache at the right layer and invalidate deliberately; a stale cache is a correctness bug wearing a performance costume.
reason: There are two hard problems: naming, cache invalidation, and off-by-one.

source_text: Commit small, atomic, independently-revertable changes; a giant commit is undebuggable and unreviewable.
pattern: Commit small, atomic, independently-revertable changes; a giant commit is undebuggable and unreviewable.
reason: Atomic commits make bisect and revert reliable.

source_text: Every change gets review before merge; review for correctness and design, not style (style belongs to automation).
pattern: Every change gets review before merge; review for correctness and design, not style (style belongs to automation).
reason: Humans review intent; machines enforce style.

source_text: Automate lint, type-check, and tests in CI and block merge on red; anything not enforced degrades over time.
pattern: Automate lint, type-check, and tests in CI and block merge on red; anything not enforced degrades over time.
reason: Ungated checks stop being run.

source_text: Ship small and often; a small deploy is easy to roll back, and frequent deploys make each one low-risk.
pattern: Ship small and often; a small deploy is easy to roll back, and frequent deploys make each one low-risk.
reason: Deploy risk is proportional to change size.

source_text: A bug you cannot reproduce, you cannot fix — capture the minimal reproducer before hypothesizing.
pattern: A bug you cannot reproduce, you cannot fix — capture the minimal reproducer before hypothesizing.
reason: The minimal reproducer is half the diagnosis.

source_text: Documentation must match actual behavior; a doc that lies is worse than no doc.
pattern: Documentation must match actual behavior; a doc that lies is worse than no doc.
reason: Wrong docs cost more than missing docs.

source_text: A README that answers what/why/how-to-run in 60 seconds is the highest-leverage doc a project has.
pattern: A README that answers what/why/how-to-run in 60 seconds is the highest-leverage doc a project has.
reason: The README is the front door of a project.

source_text: Record significant decisions as ADRs with context and alternatives; they prevent re-litigating settled questions.
pattern: Record significant decisions as ADRs with context and alternatives; they prevent re-litigating settled questions.
reason: ADR context is what the next team can't recover from code.

source_text: Docs live and die by examples: every API endpoint and every CLI flag deserves one copy-pasteable example.
pattern: Docs live and die by examples: every API endpoint and every CLI flag deserves one copy-pasteable example.
reason: Examples are the part readers actually use.

source_text: Document the why, not just the what; code shows what it does, only docs can explain the intent and constraints.
pattern: Document the why, not just the what; code shows what it does, only docs can explain the intent and constraints.
reason: Intent is the one thing code cannot express.
